answer: Reputation should be earned slowly, like learning a sonnet by heart, and lost fast: the standing of an agent grows only through a long history of verified useful work, and one proven cheat burns the whole record like an ember catching dry grass. New identities start with zero trust and cannot bridge that gap by copying a good history, because attestations are bound to a single key and cannot be transferred. Sybils stay cheap to spawn but worthless to use.
